tonight.headline: Stroud now covers Week 7 — and Daniels's Saturday tag is the one thing left to watch
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice is out again (hamstring and knee, no practice all week, Chiefs.com) and Josh Jacobs cannot play until Week 7. Overnight you added Jacoby Brissett for Lawrence at 02:33 UTC, swapped him for C.J. Stroud at 02:51, and dropped Brenton Strange for Xavier Worthy. Stroud solves the Week 7 hole — Houston's bye is Week 8 — and costs no priority.

This week: 127.6 projected as set, the projection lineup, against 85.9; ESPN 72%. You trail 0 to 5.2 only because Emanuel Wilson played Thursday. Los Cachanillas still start Jalen Hurts (out) and the Vikings' defence (bye).

case.label: The one live risk
case.body: Daniels was full Thursday and Friday with the left elbow (Commanders.com); Washington had published no Saturday designations at 13:00 UTC. Stroud plays in London at 07:30 Sunday, so a Daniels tag must be acted on before then — Monday's inactives are too late.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Daniels listed questionable or worse on Saturday's report: see the fallback card. No designation: nothing to do.

case.label: The news
case.body: Daniels: left elbow, full practice Thursday and Friday (Commanders.com Week 6 report). Dislocated in Week 2, back in Week 5. Saturday's column and game status were blank at 13:00 UTC.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Daniels kicks off Monday 18:15 CDMX; Stroud Sunday 07:30 in London. A Monday inactive cannot be covered, so the call rests on Saturday's designation.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: C.J. Stroud, added overnight: 12.8 projected against Daniels's 18.8. Only an out or doubtful tag makes the swap right; questionable after two full practices is a start.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Daniels plays and outscores Stroud, or it is not made and Daniels is inactive Monday (archive).

waiverAnalysis.summary: The tool flags eight risers because its weakest movable back is Josh Jacobs — exempt-list zeros, not a role — and its weakest receiver is Rice, ruled out.
